title: Isn't It Obvious?
author: Eliyahu M. Goldratt
description: THIS BOOK DOES FOR RETAILING WHAT GOLDRATT’S INTERNATIONAL BEST-SELLER, “THE GOAL” DID FOR MANUFACTURING.A breakthrough solution is exposed when some unexpected events force Caroline and Paul, a married couple working for their family’s retail business, to make a few small changes in the way things are done. A solution that propels the family’s regional chain of stores into a very profitable, rapidly growing, international enterprise.
